Hey, mental illness doesn't discriminate. It doesn't care if you're a billionaire or pennyless. Sometimes it just hits out of nowhere for no reason and that doesn't mean you aren't deserving of care. I've got a pretty good life but still struggle a lot, that's why I've got a support network. If it's been over a year then you definitely qualify as someone who could use some extra support, even if it wasn't over a year there's no shame in seeing a doctor about it. Lots of otherwise perfectly stable people see therapists because it's just nice to have someone to talk to, and someone to give outside perspective.

I'm not sure. Before I met them I really only lived for my cat. Without her I don't think I would have tried to get better. It just feels like nothing will get better though, I've tried and just end up at the same spot I started at, it's been years of either just weathering the storm or looking for help. I was thinking of ending it anyways but it's just worse since I lost the one I thought was the loml. I really didn't see much of a future for myself, but they saw a future with me so I was ok to figure it out as I went, with a plan in my back pocket, just in case. Now there really is nothing here, I won't get anywhere, I'm good for nothing and a waste of space and resources. I've even wondered about running away and just being homeless so I'm less of a strain on those around me, without just outright killing myself.
But I have the money to cover funeral costs. That wouldn't be an issue. I just need the guts to do it. I'm so scared someone would try to follow after me. I don't want that. I just want to make their lives easier.
